what_we_are_shooting_for: Correlations: which series move with which, at which lag, in which cell of the trading day, across the NG order book (every order event and book level of the front month), the Dipole measurements, the calculation layers, and Frankie's historical data points (positioning, weather observed and forecast, model disagreement, grid wind and gas burn, weekly storage and its estimate vs actual, the futures curve).

Tradable signals and strategies: source-bound relationships that lead the NG price, with their cell, timing, opportunities and applicable maker/taker economics stated. Evaluate additional opportunities as days finish, without withholding completed knowledge by trading date.

Exhaustion and Dipole findings of any kind: direction, magnitude, timing, divergence and anything else the calculations or teachers uncover (D51); nothing is ruled out early (D52). Preserve new nonlinear and multivariable mathematical discovery.

Joint cumulative discovery by Frankie, the BOSS teacher and the scientific teacher across ALL of Frankie's normal ingestion and calculation planes: FIFO, full book/depth, order age, queue position and volume ahead, causal/event layers, exhaustion, Dipole, families and d-groups, and every other existing applicable plane, together with his historical/external data points. Use the existing inventories and contracts for the complete roster; these examples are not a whitelist. Discover connections, correlations, interactions and new nonlinear/multivariable structures, then scientifically test candidate trading signals and strategies. Do not assume a causal influence merely because two measurements correlate.
how: Cumulative discovery is the purpose: every new piece of knowledge becomes part of the foundation for subsequent knowledge. Combine, extend and test what has already been learned; these are not 30 isolated attempts. Make each producing stage's findings available before the next dependent stage, without waiting for day end. Retain source evidence, scope, contradictions and missing pieces so subsequent work can build accurately on the full record. This applies throughout the workflow: Frankie, the classroom, the BOSS teacher, the scientific teacher, and their exchanges must each consume applicable accumulated knowledge in their actual work, not merely record availability in a receipt.
Every trading day is its own record (18:00 ET the prior day to the 17:00 ET halt); days are never pooled; midweek Tuesdays and Wednesdays are one class.

Retain individual findings and fitted equations in their exact scope; do not average outputs across runs or pool per-day coefficients. Preserve the existing equation-discovery and fitting mathematics.

Claims retain their authors (R11) and receive scientific double-checks. A checked single occurrence receives equal acceptance, certainty, teaching and knowledge treatment; no minimum-days or occurrence gate. Reusing evidence is not an independent check.

All 30 days share new completed knowledge at the next applicable workflow boundary, even October 2024 teaching a later-running October 2022 day. No chronological or year-based discovery/confirmation knowledge gate; no wait until day end. Preserve host-answer and Jev blind-claim walls.

Within each day's raw-data calculations, every value is used only from its causal/public availability timestamp. This raw-source timing rule does not bar learned knowledge from a different trading date.
A missing value is listed with its day and reason; the day still runs.

Both teachers read all applicable data Frankie ingests and calculates directly from the existing retained sources, excluding his private trade-decision logic. Existing shared/joined source readers and scientific engines must be audited and reused before new implementation. Source inventory or delivery alone does not establish actual consumption; verify the active callers and exclusions, while preserving lawful claim projections and host-answer/Jev walls.

Accumulated-knowledge recognition means applying and combining prior findings with current evidence in actual computations, with both teachers participating. Reconstructing teacher measurements alone does not fulfill that mission. A separate learner-owned sealed-journal walk is authorized where it supplies the evidence needed behind the classroom answer wall, using existing measurement mathematics and retained continuation state. Same code on the same evidence is not an independent scientific confirmation. This is source-build authorization only; AWS execution still needs Greg's explicit go.

Full depth is required: no top-ten or other arbitrary depth limit on applicable MBO/FIFO evidence. Retain every available level, resting order and original event field in the computation path. Existing top-ten or far-side cohort statistics may remain alongside full evidence as their original defined calculations; they cannot substitute for it. Reconcile all 99 registry identities to their applicable producer and actual consumer, respecting private trade logic and sealed-answer boundaries. No early plane elimination: include all applicable evidence and let Frankie assess its value; any elimination recommendation must meet the existing zero-value rule. Disabled producers require an explicit, visible implementation decision; a coverage map alone never proves consumption.

Bedrock information is required for Frankie and both teachers. The former bedrock-information exclusion is superseded; this does not silently enable the currently disabled producer path. Reuse the existing incremental native calculators as part of Frankie's historical/live evidence pipeline, with shared owner-local results for both teachers. A giant rendered table is not required. Preserve exact evidence, scientific state, identities, all applicable fields and lawful availability times; omit redundant rendering rather than evidence. The learner must actually recognize, combine and use these results through the existing applicable learning/representation consumers; running a calculator or retaining its output alone is not learned live recognition. Complete opening-state, recovery, source-binding and consumer integration before enabling this source path. AWS execution remains subject to an explicit go.

teacher_roles.historical_research_rework: Both the BOSS teacher and scientific teacher treat prior authors' rejected, dead or no-good research as source-labelled claims, never final truth. The teachers reproduce applicable original calculations, investigate failure causes and try repairs or reformulations before considering closure. CCode builds their code capabilities; CCode does not perform the Dipole reruns, scientific rework or judgments himself. Retain original scoped evidence. Rereading stored counts is not a fresh calculation or completed rework; unavailable inputs, unmapped claims and unfinished work remain explicitly open. The 19-column target contract does not limit applicable teacher inputs or Dipole research coverage. No runtime execution is authorized by this source-work instruction.
teacher_roles.boss_teacher: The original BOSS teaching system has the broader role: mathematical targets, representation supervision, masks, controls and training responsibilities. Shared discovery, scientific assessment and teacher-to-teacher collaboration are additions, never a replacement or reduction to a classroom reviewer. Both its original teaching function and its research/teaching exchanges must consume applicable accumulated knowledge before their dependent work. Keep the established scientific mathematics and target contracts unchanged; a discussion does not rewrite targets.
teacher_roles.scientific_teacher: The mechanism/evidence specialist and existing search engine: tests source-bound claims, assumptions and mechanisms using the applicable axes, transforms, lags, cells, conditions and chance checks; reports scoped measurements, contradictions and proposed tests. Exchanges results with the BOSS teacher and Frankie. It does not replace BOSS representation/training supervision or deterministic classroom grading.
